problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$D=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 6 & 5 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}].$

activity_context.topic_title: The Determinant of an NxN Matrix

feedback.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${p}_{35}$, we remove the $3$rd row and $5$th column: 

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}3 & -8 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ 3 & 5 & \sqrt{13} & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -4 \\ 4 & 8 & 3 & 8 & ∗ \\ 11 & 3 & \sqrt{2} & -9 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{35}=|\begin{aligned}3 & -8 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 5 & \sqrt{13} & 0 \\ 4 & 8 & 3 & 8 \\ 11 & 3 & \sqrt{2} & -9\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${p}_{35}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{35} & =(-1)^{3+5}{M}_{35} \\  & ={M}_{35} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}3 & -8 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 5 & \sqrt{13} & 0 \\ 4 & 8 & 3 & 8 \\ 11 & 3 & \sqrt{2} & -9\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
